description: Spearheaded the migration to Jetpack Compose, architected multi-module Clean Architecture, and optimized CI/CD pipelines to scale a flagship app.
bullets: Spearheaded the complete migration of the flagship app from XML/Views to Jetpack Compose, reducing UI rendering times by 35% and improving developer velocity.
Architected a multi-module Clean Architecture pattern using MVVM and Hilt, establishing a solid foundation for testability and parallel development.
Optimized CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, reducing build times by 40% and implementing automated robust UI testing protocols.
Mentored a team of 4 mid-level engineers, establishing coding standards and conducting rigorous architectural reviews.

description: Led financial data integration with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow, secured sensitive user data, and refactored a legacy Java codebase to Kotlin.
bullets: Led the integration of complex financial data streams using Kotlin Coroutines and Flow, ensuring real-time UI updates without main thread blocking.
Implemented secure biometric authentication and end-to-end encryption for sensitive user financial data.
Refactored legacy Java codebase to Kotlin, increasing crash-free sessions to 99.9% over a 6-month period.

description: Developed internal logistics tracking apps used by thousands of field agents and integrated real-time mapping with offline sync.
bullets: Developed and maintained a suite of internal logistics tracking applications used by over 5,000 field agents daily.
Integrated Google Maps API for real-time fleet routing and offline sync capabilities using Room Database.
